release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.9.3 Release — Bulletproof YouTube Shorts Blocker & Zero-Permission Interception:
• Pure Accessibility Interception: Completely eliminated background startActivity() calls. Zero 'High-risk operation' security warnings on Xiaomi/HyperOS, and no special background pop-up permission needed to intercept Shorts.
• Native Bottom Tab Switching: When the Shorts pivot tab is tapped, FocusDefend automatically simulates a click on the Home tab via AccessibilityNodeInfo (pivot_bar index 0) across all languages and YouTube versions.
• Native Reel Player Back Ejection: When a Short is opened from a shelf or carousel, GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK pops the player instantly in 0ms without closing the YouTube app.
• Standalone 24/7 Toggle: Added dedicated 'Block YouTube Shorts' setting in Student Settings so Shorts can be blocked continuously without requiring an active study session.
